entities.summary: Mais Barkhudarov is an Azerbaijani officer, lieutenant general of Armed Forces of Azerbaijan, who was a participant of 2016 Nagorno-Karabakh clashes and 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh war. He was the commander of the 2nd Army Corps of Azerbaijan in October 2014 - October 2024.
